title: Relation
description: A reified triple: `subject —predicate→ object`, authored by a person and stored on THEIR vault. One ontology for every lightweight edge between envelopes — a reaction (predicate 'react', value '👍'), a pin (predicate 'pin', value 'me'|'all'), a mention notification, a response to an activity (predicate 'respond') — instead of one bespoke ontology per edge kind. `object` is a w3ds envelope URI so the edge survives relocation. Distinct from the registered `Reference` ontology (c20e9437-…), which is a review/score OF a target; a Relation is a statement BETWEEN two envelopes. A cross-vault copy uses the reference mixin (isReference + canonicalOwnerEName + canonicalRelationId): the source-of-truth edge stays on the author's vault.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

subject.description: Who/what the statement is about — an eName or a w3ds envelope URI

value.description: Predicate-specific payload: the emoji for 'react', 'me'|'all' for 'pin'

authorId.description: @-prefixed eName of whoever asserted the relation

isReference.description: True on a cross-vault copy pointing at the canonical

canonicalOwnerEName.description: Reference mixin: whose vault holds the canonical

canonicalRelationId.description: Reference mixin: metaEnvelope id of the canonical

sharedBy.description: Reference mixin: who fanned the copy out
